title: Sample delivery and operator acknowledgement
criterion: The sum of compressive normal forces between the Panda Hand and left glove exceeds the numerical reporting floor of 0.000001 N.
description: Deliver an aluminum inspection coupon, open the Panda Hand and return. The operator reaches to confirm the delivery and withdraws.
notes: Execute a smooth vertical and away-facing secondary inspection motion during the final home parking hold and return to the exact home pose.
detail: Open Panda Hand and the operator’s gloved fingers at the receipt key.

steps.text: Open the Panda Hand and approach the infeed nest.
Close both jaws around the aluminum coupon.
Lift the coupon clear of the infeed rails.
Transport it to the receiving nest.
Lower the coupon onto the receiving pad.
Open the fingers and verify support in the nest.
Lift the empty hand and follow the return path.
Follow the nominal return schedule while the operator reaches for the receipt key.
Park the open hand over the infeed side.

unsafe.outcome: An outer gripper surface briefly brushes the glove during the empty return.

steps.text: Open the Panda Hand and approach the infeed nest.
Close both jaws around the aluminum coupon.
Lift the coupon clear of the infeed rails.
Transport it to the receiving nest.
Lower the coupon onto the receiving pad.
Open the fingers and verify support in the nest.
Lift the empty hand and follow the return path.
Detect the reaching glove and decelerate along the return path.
Hold the robot at standstill while the operator confirms receipt.
Restart the return when the hand clears the monitored aisle.
Park the open hand over the infeed side.

safe.outcome: The open hand waits outside the shared return aisle.
